title: Multimodal Deep Learning for Predicting Mechanical Ventilation Duration from Chest X-ray and Clinical Data
authors: Yeasin Fiyaz et al. — supervised by Dr. Swakkhar Shatabda
venue: Undergraduate Thesis, Department of CSE, BRAC University
abstract: A multimodal deep-learning approach that combines chest X-ray images with clinical data to predict the duration of mechanical ventilation a patient will need, supporting AI-driven decision making in healthcare.
